purpose: Define the final future boundary for claiming WindowsUtility productization readiness only after all upstream evidence, artifact, release, acceptance, and authority gates pass.

preconditions.description: The real WindowsUtility package artifact must pass extraction inventory verification.
Packaged executable launch smoke and packaged UI screenshot evidence must pass if product acceptance depends on runnable packaged behavior.
The user/coordinator must accept the product candidate.
Installer, signing, and release status must be recorded as completed, intentionally deferred, or not applicable with evidence.
Release authority must be resolved as completed, deferred, or not applicable before productization can be claimed.
The user/coordinator must explicitly authorize the final productization readiness claim.

futureAllowedIfAuthorizedLater: record final productization readiness report under generated/
link all upstream verification, product candidate, installer, signing, and release evidence
record known limitations and intentionally deferred gates
mark productization ready only if final authority is explicitly accepted
futureStillForbiddenIfProductizationAuth: WindowsUtility source edits unless separately authorized
provider API calls unless separately authorized
